from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    a = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(a), len(a[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in a for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    frames = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if a[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = a[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                rr, cc = q.popleft()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and a[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
            r0, r1 = min(x for x,y in cells), max(x for x,y in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(y for x,y in cells), max(y for x,y in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            if len(cells) != 2*(r1-r0+1) + 2*(c1-c0+1) - 4:
                continue
            if not all(a[rr][cc] == color for rr,cc in
                       ([(r0,cc) for cc in range(c0,c1+1)] + [(r1,cc) for cc in range(c0,c1+1)] +
                        [(rr,c0) for rr in range(r0+1,r1)] + [(rr,c1) for rr in range(r0+1,r1)])):
                continue
            frames.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in frames:
        ih, iw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
        fill = 7 if ih % 2 == 1 and iw % 2 == 1 else 2
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                a[r][c] = fill
    return a
'''
